name: AI Logic {OS}
tagline: When to use deterministic code and when to use model judgment.

commands.name: /ai-logic arbitrate <step>
commands.summary: Put one named step in exactly one bin: codify, augment, keep human, or delete.

commands.name: /ai-logic map <process>
commands.summary: Turn a process that lives in people's heads into numbered steps with owner and duration.

commands.name: /ai-logic baseline <process>
commands.summary: Establish volume, time, error rate and cost, or specify the measurement device.

commands.name: /ai-logic triage
commands.summary: Bin every step of a mapped and measured process, deletions announced first.

commands.name: /ai-logic math <candidate>
commands.summary: Annual gain against build plus maintenance, with every input visible.

commands.name: /ai-logic verifier <output>
commands.summary: Name the falsifier a consequential model output must carry, or refuse the step.

commands.name: /ai-logic challenge <system>
commands.summary: Interrogate an agentic system against five questions, every finding cited.

commands.name: /ai-logic spec
commands.summary: Specify the first approved move only, build ready, with a done test and rollback.

requires_human_approval_for: recording a verdict that contradicts a decision the user already shipped
writing an estimated rather than observed baseline into canonical memory
recommending deletion of a process that has a named external consumer
accepting execution statistics as a replacement for a human gate on an irreversible action
